payout_quote: Inspectors are provided a stipend of: $240 on Early Voting Days; $360 on Election Day. Clerks are provided a stipend of: $160 on Early Voting Days; $250 on Election Day. Bilingual poll workers receive an additional stipend of $25 on Early Voting Days and $40 on Election Day (Spanish, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Nepali). Be available to serve during: Early Voting Days approx 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; Election Day approx 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
steps: Be a registered voter in California, or a permanent legal resident of the US residing in California (Clerks only); available for the listed hours; able to follow written and verbal instructions.
Apply online at sonomacounty.gov Registrar of Voters poll-worker page or email rov-polls@sonomacounty.gov.
Serve as a Clerk (3-8 per Vote Center) on Early Voting Days and/or Election Day at an assigned Vote Center.
Work the posted shift: Early Voting Days approximately 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; Election Day approximately 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. (setup/cleaning/closing are clerk duties within the posted window).
catches: Election-period work only; stipend-based per-day pay.
Must be available the full hours: approx 8am-6pm early voting; approx 6am-10pm Election Day.
This route is framed on Clerks only - Inspector rates ($240/$360) are excluded because Inspector training (in-person class plus online videos of unstated duration) cannot be fully quantified.
Bilingual bonus requires English plus one of the listed needed languages.
biggest_catch: Clerk Election Day is a ~16-hour commitment (approx 6am-10pm) for a flat $250 stipend; Inspector roles are excluded from this framing.
eligibility: Registered CA voter (Inspectors), or permanent US legal resident residing in CA (Clerks); available full shift; able to follow instructions.
timing: Early Voting Days and Election Day per the county election calendar.
